title: Captain — An AI travel agent
excerpt: An AI travel agent on Telegram. Talk through any trip to organize plans, look up live prices, and prepare.
content_html:
Captain is an AI travel agent. It can help with general travel planning tasks, like exploring an itinerary, looking up live prices, or watching for when best to book a flight.

It includes a visual workspace to manage your trip that shows you what the agent is considering, lets you adjust preferences, and keeps the plan in view as you go.

Capabilities

  • Talks through any trip

    Early ideas or firm plans — including trips months away. Ask in plain language and keep the conversation going as details change.

  • Looks up live prices

    When you’re ready, Captain checks live flight data and helps you compare options without starting from a blank search form.

  • Organizes the plan

    Cities, soft dates, events, and constraints stay in one place as the trip takes shape — from first sketch to booking prep.

  • Handles complex itineraries

    One-way, round-trip, and multi-city — including soft windows like “before Wednesday” or “the first week of May.”

  • Remembers your preferences

    Cabin, stop limits, budget, airlines you prefer or avoid — Captain uses them when ranking what it finds.

  • Watches for better options

    Once you lock in the trip, Captain checks prices daily and alerts you only when something meaningfully changes.

Fares are provided by Duffel and may change or expire.

Workspace

Manage your trip in a visual workspace. Browse what the agent is considering, adjust preferences, and keep the plan in view as you go.

FAQs

How do I use Captain?

Open Captain on Telegram and talk about your trip in your own words — early ideas, cities, dates, constraints, or questions while you prepare. Voice notes work too.

What trips work best?

Any stage, from first sketch to booking prep. Complicated itineraries — multi-city routes, soft dates, events you need to hit — are a sweet spot, but you don’t need a finished plan to start.

Does Captain book flights?

No. It helps you plan and compare. You choose the itinerary and book yourself.

content_html_zh:
Captain是一位人工智能旅行社。 它可以帮助完成一般旅行计划任务，例如探索行程、查找实时价格或了解预订航班的最佳时间。

它包括一个用于管理您的旅行的可视化工作区，向您显示代理正在考虑的内容，让您调整偏好，并在您出行时随时查看计划。

能力

  • 讨论任何旅行 早期的想法或坚定的计划——包括几个月后的旅行。 用简单的语言提问，并在细节发生变化时保持对话继续。
  • 查找实时价格 当您准备好时，Captain 会检查实时航班数据并帮助您比较选项，而无需从空白搜索表单开始。
  • 组织计划 随着旅行的形成，从最初的草图到预订准备，城市、软日期、活动和限制都集中在一个地方。
  • 处理复杂的行程单程、往返和多城市 - 包括“周三之前”或“五月第一周”等软窗口。
  • 记住您的偏好机舱、停靠点限制、预算、您喜欢或避免的航空公司 - Captain 在对找到的内容进行排名时会使用它们。
  • 关注更好的选择 一旦您锁定行程，Captain 会每天检查价格，并仅在出现有意义的变化时提醒您。

票价由 Duffel 提供，可能会更改或过期。

工作空间

在可视化工作空间中管理您的旅行。 浏览代理正在考虑的内容，调整偏好，并在执行过程中随时关注计划。

FAQs

How do I use Captain?

打开 Telegram 上的 Captain，用自己的话谈论您的旅行 - 准备时的早期想法、城市、日期、限制或问题。 语音笔记也有效。

What trips work best?

从最初的草图到预订准备的任何阶段。 复杂的行程——多城市路线、软日期、你需要参加的活动——是一个不错的选择，但你不需要一个完整的计划来开始。

Does Captain book flights?

不会。它可以帮助您计划和比较。 您自行选择行程并预订。
